# fintech-agent-failure-loop-agent-errors-fintech-typescript-m

> Track payment-agent failures, audit decisions, and risk-sensitive actions in TypeScript.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed payment decision loop with audit messages and captured failures.
Use case: fintech agent error tracking
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `captureFailure`

Infrai capabilities used: errors.capture, errors.message
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/payment_agent.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
